system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Just got an email offering Premium for £99 for a year, but when I follow the link through, it says I am not eligible. It also says "If you'd like you can still upgrade your account to premium at any time."..but I am on Premium :("

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey there! Can you send us your account's email address or username via DM? We'll take a look backstage /JE <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Requesting personal info publicly; should ask to DM instead for privacy."}
